clue.text: Urge a senior teacher to continue the good work

parts.note: to urge is to press someone
a head is the senior teacher of a school

explanation.surface: A plea to the headmistress to keep up her fine efforts.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep going with determination is to push on with a task.

clue.text: Rebel to get an increase in pay

definitions.meaning: a raise in salary or wages

explanation.definitionFit: To revolt is to rise up, and a pay hike is a raise in salary.

clue.text: Change the phrase, there's an angel

indicators.note: Change tells us to alter the letters of phrase into a new order

explanation.surface: Reword it, and a heavenly being appears.
explanation.definitionFit: A seraph is one of the highest order of celestial beings.

clue.text: Failure to remember distressed men in Eastern countries

indicators.note: in places the jumbled men inside the word for eastern countries

parts.note: Asia is the continent of eastern countries

indicators.note: distressed says the letters of men are disordered

explanation.surface: Upset men in the East forget things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distressed' scrambles the men, and 'in' places them inside the eastern landmass, after its opening letter; 'Failure to remember' is the definition, not a hint of anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Amnesia is loss of memory.

clue.text: Paradise in Avon

definitions.meaning: the garden where Adam and Eve lived
Anthony ..., the former Prime Minister, became Earl of Avon

explanation.walkthrough: The British Prime Minister Anthony Eden was made Earl of Avon in 1961; Avon is also an English county and river.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical garden is paradise, and the Prime Minister took the title Earl of Avon.

clue.text: Tried to renovate an American city

indicators.note: renovate says the letters of tried to are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone attempted to restore a US city.
explanation.definitionFit: Detroit is the motor city of Michigan.

clue.text: To walk on island with wife is quite proper

parts.note: leg it is slang for to walk or go on foot
mate is an informal word for a spouse

explanation.surface: Strolling on an island with one's wife is perfectly respectable.
explanation.definitionFit: Something legitimate is lawful and properly in order.

clue.text: Group setting guide-lines for the subjugation of physical passions

definitions.text: Group setting guide-lines for the subjugation of physical passions

parts.words: Group setting guide-lines for the subjugation of physical passions
parts.note: a governing committee sets rules; read literally, controlling one's flesh is governing the physique

explanation.definitionFit: A governing council sets the rules an organisation follows.

clue.text: Fashionable agent returns from South American country

indicators.note: returns says the pieces before it are read from right to left

parts.note: U means upper-class, so fashionable or socially acceptable
a rep is a sales agent, short for representative

explanation.surface: A trendy representative comes home from Latin America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns U plus REP backwards to give PER then U.
explanation.definitionFit: Peru is a nation on the Pacific coast of the continent.

clue.text: Severe strain unsettled the man

indicators.note: unsettled says the letters of strain are disturbed into a new order

parts.note: gent, short for gentleman, means the man

explanation.surface: A man unsettled by a harsh strain on him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unsettled' rearranges STRAIN into ASTRIN, followed by GENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Astringent criticism is harsh and severe.

clue.text: The border in one Italian resort

parts.note: a rim is the border or edge of something
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone describes the edge of a holiday town in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Rimini is a seaside town on the Adriatic coast, popular with holidaymakers.

clue.text: Plant post-war spy by Iowa

parts.note: Klaus Fuchs was the physicist convicted in 1950 of passing atomic secrets to the Soviets
IA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Iowa

explanation.surface: A Cold War spy sets up a plant beside an Iowa farm.
explanation.definitionFit: Fuchsia is a flowering shrub with drooping bell-shaped blooms.

clue.text: Rushing to an apartment in Ascot, perhaps

parts.note: a flat is an apartment
racing means rushing along

explanation.surface: Someone hurries to their flat in a Berkshire town.
explanation.walkthrough: Ascot is a famous British racecourse in Berkshire, home to Royal Ascot, a meeting held on the flat, without jumps.
explanation.definitionFit: Horse races without jumps are held at courses such as this one.

clue.text: Pale, richly textured cheese

indicators.note: textured says the letters of pale richly are woven into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A description of a pale, rich-textured cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'textured' rearranges PALE RICHLY. Caerphilly is a crumbly white Welsh cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Caerphilly is a mild crumbly white variety from Wales.

clue.text: Part-time dealer tries to be on the ball

indicators.note: Part-time says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A part-time dealer makes an effort to stay sharp.
explanation.definitionFit: Being watchful and quick to respond is being on the ball.

clue.text: Satan in in decline

definitions.meaning: the devil is the king of sin, read as two words

explanation.walkthrough: Satan, read whimsically, is the monarch of wickedness: SIN KING.
explanation.definitionFit: Satan rules over wickedness as its monarch, and a ship or fortune going down is failing.

clue.text: Individual performances unaffected by reversal

indicators.note: unaffected by reversal says the answer reads the same either way

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Performers going it alone don't mind a turnaround.
explanation.definitionFit: Solos are pieces performed by one person alone.

clue.text: Distribute nothing but the Hebrew Scriptures

parts.note: all can mean nothing but, as in 'it was all lies'
OT is the Old Testament, the Hebrew Scriptures

explanation.surface: A command to hand out only Old Testament texts.
explanation.definitionFit: To allocate shares to people is to give each a portion.

clue.text: The high spot is when Father returns to former wife

indicators.note: returns says the word for Father is read backwards

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
an ex is a former wife or partner

explanation.surface: Dad going back to his ex-wife is the best moment.
explanation.definitionFit: The summit is the topmost point of anything.

clue.text: Can love be found in Ireland?

parts.note: may and can both express permission
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A question whether romance exists on the Emerald Isle.
explanation.definitionFit: Mayo is a county in the west of the country.

clue.text: Litter makes the bishop cross

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
a rood is a cross or crucifix, especially in a church

explanation.surface: Rubbish annoys the bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: A litter is a family of young animals born together.

clue.text: Given a meal of French cheese, as instructed

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese
fed means given food

explanation.surface: Someone was served French cheese as ordered.
explanation.definitionFit: To be briefed is to be given instructions in advance.

clue.text: Beloved lighthouse heroine

definitions.meaning: Grace ..., keeper's daughter who rowed to rescue shipwrecked sailors in 1838

explanation.definitionFit: A sweetheart is a dear one, and Grace of that name rescued survivors from a wreck off Northumberland.

clue.text: To criticise wine requires understanding

parts.note: to rap is to criticise sharply
port is a fortified wine from Portugal

explanation.surface: Being able to criticise wine needs knowledge.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapport is a close relationship of mutual sympathy.

clue.text: Yet it's a form of overindulgence

indicators.note: a form of says the letters of the preceding words take another shape

explanation.surface: A remark that something is yet another kind of excess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a form of' rearranges YET IT'S A.
explanation.definitionFit: Satiety is being filled beyond the point of desire.

clue.text: Charge for a popular little dictionary

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
dict is the short form of dictionary

explanation.surface: A fee for a well-liked pocket dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: To indict is to formally accuse of a crime.

clue.text: Shrink from giving credit to a gloomy dean

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
William Inge, Dean of St Paul's, was nicknamed the Gloomy Dean

explanation.surface: Someone recoils from praising a miserable cleric.
explanation.definitionFit: To cower is to draw back in fear or embarrassment.

clue.text: He takes advantage of a disheartened usher

indicators.note: disheartened says the middle letter is taken from usher

explanation.surface: An exploitative man has a discouraged usher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' removes the heart of USHER, its middle letter H.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who exploits others is one who uses them.

clue.text: Mr Kennedy's game?

definitions.meaning: Ludovic Kennedy, the British broadcaster, was known by this nickname
a board game played with dice and counters

explanation.walkthrough: Sir Ludovic Kennedy was a British broadcaster and author.
explanation.definitionFit: The broadcaster's short name matches the dice-and-counters board game.

clue.text: Hypercritical of how quickly had contracted debts

parts.note: fast means quickly
I'd is the shortened form of 'I had'
IOUs are written promises of debts owed

explanation.surface: A fussy remark about how fast debts were run up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'had contracted' is I HAD shortened to I'D, not debts taken on.
explanation.definitionFit: A fussy person is extremely particular and hard to please.

clue.text: Nothing found by the side of Egyptian river

parts.note: nil means nothing
E for East is one side or player in bridge

explanation.surface: Nothing turned up on the banks of the river in Egypt.
explanation.definitionFit: The great river flows north through Egypt to the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Disparagement of French religious supplication

parts.note: de is French for of
rogation is solemn prayer, as on the Rogation Days

explanation.surface: Contempt for a French form of prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Derogation is belittling or detracting from someone's worth.
